title: ALLOW_TRUST fails with ALLOW_TRUST_CANT_REVOKE
pattern: A transaction whose ALLOW_TRUST operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (cant_revoke). An issuer without AUTH_REVOCABLE tries to revoke an authorized NRV trustline.

hazards.placement: AllowTrust revoking from an issuer without AUTH_REVOCABLE

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
